text:
Alex Nguyen: Hey team — CI red on my feature branch `quant-stepper` after last rebase to main. Build failed on linux-gpu shard. cc @ci-bot
ci-bot: Build #4721 failed on eng-gpu-3 (linux/gcc-11). Failure excerpt:
```
FAILED tests/test_kv_eviction.py::test_eviction_pressure - AssertionError: expected 42 got 0
.../build/obj/libkv.a: undefined reference to `kv_compact'
```
Maria Ortiz: Oof. Did you try rerunning the shard? Sometimes flakes.
Alex Nguyen: Ran `./dev/ci rerun 4721 --shard 3` — same failure. I can reproduce locally with `pytest tests/test_kv_eviction.py::test_eviction_pressure -k 'gpu'` and get same assertion.
Samir Patel: Can you paste the full failing stack? Also any local env diffs (CUDA/driver)?
Alex Nguyen: Stack:
```
E   AssertionError: buffers not freed
> tests/test_kv_eviction.py:87
```
Jen Li: Noticed a recent change in `third_party/kv` in main — there was a small API rename. Maybe your branch missed that. Any merge conflicts during rebase?
Alex Nguyen: There was a conflict in `third_party/kv/CMakeLists.txt` I resolved, but I probably kept old API calls.
Maria Ortiz: Quick bisect could help. If you want, I can run a bisect job on CI.
Alex Nguyen: Would really appreciate that — I want to avoid another rebase if possible.
ci-bot: To start a CI bisect, comment `@ci-bot bisect 2105016789 --since=main~20` — this will run parallel builds to find first break.
Samir Patel: Alternatively, you can `git bisect` locally:
```
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good origin/main~20
# run tests, mark good/bad
```
Alex Nguyen: Kicking off local bisect now. If it fails to finish, please run CI bisect @Maria.
Maria Ortiz: Will queue CI bisect in ~10m if local doesn't finish. Also pinging @Jen to double-check `third_party/kv` header changes.
Jen Li: On it. Quick look shows `kv_compact` moved into `kv/compact.h` and signature changed from `(kv_t*)` to `(kv_t*, int)`. That explains the undefined reference.
Alex Nguyen: Ah thanks — I must have kept old call sites. I'll update and push a fix and re-run CI.
Alex Nguyen: Pushed fix in 2105016833. Rerunning `./dev/ci rerun 4721 --shard 3` now.
ci-bot: Rerun started.
Jen Li: If CI passes, we should add a small test wrapper to make future API changes fail faster.
Samir Patel: Agreed. Also add a short note in CHANGELOG for the kv API change.
Alex Nguyen: Sounds good. I'll add test wrapper and changelog in follow-up PR.
Maria Ortiz: Thanks all! :thumbsup: 
Alex Nguyen: Thanks :pray:
